summary: Night relief 2026-10-31: planner lease-pushes the stranded reviewed worktree branches (1138, 1140, 1135, 1072, 785, 940, 655.3) after rebase from a scrubbed shell, marks drafts ready, dispatch lands them

options.description: Rebase each stranded branch onto origin/main from a shell without AI_SDLC_EXECUTOR_TASK / AI_SDLC_HIERARCHY_* so the pre-push gates run clean and re-sign, lease-push, gh pr ready; dispatch arms and lands
Wait for AISDLC-1137/1138/1139 to land and let the reconciler reclaim the branches
Re-run each task through a fresh executor

body: Operator instruction 2026-10-31 (going to bed): autonomous mode, clear the open PRs. Seven worktrees hold approved, reviewed commits that never reached origin because (1) executor env leaked into the pre-push patch-coverage test run and (2) step 11 first push was plain against an existing remote branch. Class (a): lease push to non-protected task branches is reversible, the pre-push hooks and attestation path are unchanged, no control is loosened. opt-b blocks on three PRs that are themselves stranded; opt-c burns executor hours re-doing reviewed work.
